results.title: Hot Wheels Stunt Show Coming To San Diego On First U.S. Tour
results.description: The live arena show will bring full-size Hot Wheels cars, jumps, drifting and a 45-foot loop to Pechanga Arena.

results.title: Al Roker explains unexpected reason for leaving Today show mid-broadcast
results.description: Today show weatherman Al Roker disappeared mid-broadcast on Monday, Sept. 28, and took to his Instagram to explain the surprising reason for his sudden absence

results.title: Songs in Ursa Minor: Yes’ Rick Wakeman Performed a Private Show for 150 Rescue Bears
results.description: The prog-rock legend appeared at a Vietnamese animal sanctuary to raise awareness of bears kept forced to have their bile extracted for traditional Chinese medicines
